datasets.title: Pharmaceutical trade by country
datasets.description: Exports and imports of pharmaceutical products (HS 30) and of antibiotics as ingredients (HS 2941), US$, 2024, with 2025 where reported (UN Comtrade). Shares are of the total reported by all countries.

datasets.title: Current US drug shortages
datasets.description: Every shortage listed as current in the FDA Drug Shortages Database on 2026-11-06, grouped by generic name, with when it was first posted, its forms, therapeutic categories and the reasons manufacturers gave (openFDA).

datasets.title: US shortages by therapeutic category
datasets.description: How many current US shortages fall in each FDA therapeutic category. A medicine can be in several (openFDA).

datasets.title: Reasons given for US shortages
datasets.description: How many current US shortages cite each reason. A shortage can have several, given by different manufacturers (openFDA).

datasets.title: US drug shortages per year, 2011 to 2025
datasets.description: New shortages, shortages prevented and shortages still ongoing at the end of each year, as stated in FDA's annual reports to Congress. Counts before 2016 are CDER only.

datasets.title: Where active ingredients are made for US medicines
datasets.description: Regional shares of active-ingredient manufacturing locations for products with a US applicant, 2020 and 2025 (FDA Report on the State of Pharmaceutical Quality, FY2025).

datasets.title: EU critical medicines by body system
datasets.description: Active substances on the Union list of critical medicines, grouped by ATC anatomical main group (EMA).

datasets.title: Shortages in EMA's catalogue
datasets.description: Every shortage in the European Medicines Agency's public catalogue, with its status, therapeutic area and dates.

datasets.title: Price concessions in England, monthly
datasets.description: Generic medicines and pack sizes granted a price concession by DHSC each month, 2014-01 to 2026-10 (Community Pharmacy England).

datasets.title: Serious Shortage Protocols in force
datasets.description: UK Serious Shortage Protocols active on 6 November 2026 (NHSBSA).

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the three maps.

datasets.title: Headline findings
datasets.description: Published figures from FDA, EMA and NHSBSA.
